_comment: Auto-pairing rules for the parity gate. Data, not code: adding a rule is a
reviewable line here rather than a patch to check-parity.mjs.
A rule that pairs two items which are not the same capability is worse than
no rule at all, because a pair suppresses a report. `check-parity.mjs`
refuses to run when two ids on one surface normalise to the same string,
which catches a rule that collapses distinct items.
